item.title: Snapchat Lens Creator
item.description: Updated October 2026 with current Lens Insights figures from my LinkedIn featured post. I started making Snapchat lenses for fun in 2017 and ended up with a small Fiverr side business, a utility other creators still use, and a phone call with Snapchat about Lens Studio.
